subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] mm/swap: refault on swap-in, not in the swap cache allocator

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch moves the evaluation of page refaults from the swap cache allocator to the two swap-in callers, which read the slot's shadow before allocation overwrites it. This change prevents inflated workingset_refault_anon and workingset_activate_anon counts on workloads that continuously write back data. The refault is still evaluated before adding the folio to the LRU list, ensuring PG_workingset/PG_active flags are set correctly.
